questions.stem_text: Which mass is undergoing the greatest amount of acceleration?

options.A: 1 kg subjected to a force of 1 N
options.B: 1 kg subjected to a force of 100 N
options.C: 100 kg subjected to a force of 1 N
options.D: 100 kg subjected to a force of 100 N

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - 1 kg subjected to a force of 100 N

questions.stem_text:
Rocks sometimes show evidence of ancient glaciers. Which is the best sign that glaciers
once covered an area?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Rocks have many scratches.

questions.stem_text: Which group consists only of living things?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - rabbit, seed, bird

questions.stem_text:
An engineer is analyzing which areas in a city might become flooded if there are heavy
rains. Which of the following maps is best to use for this analysis?

options.A: a map showing the routes of city buses
options.B: a map showing the locations of streets
options.C: a map showing the locations of houses
options.D: a map showing the elevations of ground surfaces

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - a map showing the elevations of ground surfaces
